meaning: ~ or ~ (or something); do one thing or another (a non-exhaustive choice of options)

exercises.example_sentence: 分からないことがあれば、辞書で調べるなり先生に聞くなりしなさい。
exercises.translation: If there's something you don't understand, look it up in a dictionary or ask the teacher—do one or the other.
wrong_choice_explanations: やら…やら lists a jumble of things that happened ('what with A and B'), not options to choose from. 調べるやら先生に聞くなり also breaks the matched pair, and a chaotic list can't feed the command しなさい; the parallel なり…なり offers 'A or B, either will do'.

だの…だの lists things with a note of complaint ('this and that, on and on'), which doesn't suit a teacher's advice. 調べるだの先生に聞くなり also mismatches the paired particle; the command しなさい needs matched なり…なり to offer a free choice.

とか…とか lists examples and pairs with itself (AとかBとか). 調べるとか先生に聞くなり mixes two different list markers, so the pair is broken; the second item's なり requires なり on the first item too, giving 'A or B, whichever' before the command しなさい.
exercises.hiragana_full: わからないことがあれば、じしょでしらべるなりせんせいにきくなりしなさい。
